children: The Hartford terminated its Aggregate Excess of Loss Reinsurance Agreement with National Indemnity through a Reinsurance Commutation and Release Agreement. The commutation became effective on Sep 25 2026 upon The Hartford’s receipt of $1.12 billion in cash and resolves an ongoing arbitration between the parties. The company expects to recognize a before tax net gain of $497 million and increase net income by $393 million for the third quarter, with no impact on core earnings.
: Aggregate Excess of Loss Reinsurance Agreement (asbestos and environmental adverse development cover)
: Resolve arbitration and end retroactive reinsurance
